resources.title: Principal Component Analysis Explained Visually
resources.about: An interactive page: drag points in 2D and see the new axes PCA picks, then the same idea in 3D and with 17 variables.
resources.use: When you want to see what principal components do to a cloud of points before doing the algebra.

resources.title: A Tutorial on Principal Component Analysis
resources.about: A self-contained tutorial that builds PCA from a toy example: centring, the covariance matrix, diagonalising it, and the same result from the SVD.
resources.use: For one careful derivation of PCA from both the eigenvector and the SVD side.

resources.title: Lecture 7: Eckart-Young: The Closest Rank k Matrix to A (18.065)
resources.about: Strang reviews PCA on centred data with the n − 1 sample covariance, contrasts its perpendicular distances with least squares, and states Eckart–Young.
resources.use: For how PCA and the best low-rank approximation are the same question.

resources.title: Data-Driven Science & Engineering, Chapter 1 (Section 1.5: PCA)
resources.by: Steven L. Brunton and J. Nathan Kutz
resources.about: The book's chapter 1 page, with videos per section; section 1.5 covers PCA, with an overview and worked versions in MATLAB and Python.
resources.use: For short video walk-throughs of PCA as an application of the SVD.

resources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning, Chapter 10: Dimensionality Reduction with PCA
resources.by: Deisenroth, Faisal and Ong (Cambridge University Press)
resources.about: The book's site, with a free PDF; chapter 10 treats PCA as the direction of maximum variance and as the best projection.
resources.use: For PCA in machine-learning notation, at book length.

resources.title: Principal component analysis (Wikipedia)
resources.about: Reference article: the covariance and SVD routes, scores, explained variance, how many components to keep, and links to related methods.
resources.use: To look up a PCA definition, convention or property quickly.

resources.title: Decomposing signals in components (scikit-learn user guide)
resources.about: The user guide for scikit-learn's matrix decompositions, starting with PCA: it centres each feature and uses the SVD.
resources.use: When you want to run PCA in Python and know what the library does to your data.
